contrib.config.title: JetBrains Git Control
contrib.config.locale: User-interface language for the JGC panels. Leave empty to follow the VS Code display language automatically (recommended). Set a value such as `en` or `zh-cn` to force a language. Requires a window reload to take effect.
contrib.config.blame.displayMode.desc: Controls which lines show inline Git blame annotations.
contrib.config.blame.displayMode.all: Annotate every line of the file
contrib.config.blame.displayMode.cursor: Only the line under the cursor
contrib.config.blame.displayMode.around: The cursor line plus N lines of context (see #jgc.blame.aroundLines#)
contrib.config.blame.aroundLines.desc: Lines of context above/below the cursor when jgc.blame.displayMode is 'around'.
contrib.config.blame.columns.desc: Which columns to show in inline Git blame annotations. Display order is always: Revision → Date → Author → Commit Number.
contrib.config.blame.columns.author: Author name
contrib.config.blame.colorMode.desc: How inline Git blame annotations are colored.
contrib.config.blame.colorMode.author: A distinct color per author
contrib.config.blame.colorMode.order: JetBrains-style coloring by commit age: recent commits stand out, old ones fade
contrib.config.blame.nameStyle.desc: How the author name is displayed in inline Git blame annotations.
contrib.config.blame.dateFormat.desc: Date format for inline blame annotations. Tokens: yyyy MM dd HH mm ss.
contrib.config.blame.light.desc: Inline blame annotation color for light themes.
contrib.config.blame.dark.desc: Inline blame annotation color for dark themes.
contrib.config.worktree.openBehavior.des: Controls how projects are opened from Git worktrees.
contrib.config.worktree.ask: Always ask which window to open in
contrib.config.worktree.thisWindow: Always open in the current window
contrib.config.worktree.newWindow: Always open in a new window
